## Où j'en suis
PR #233 is merged and the real replay finished: all 18,442,107 events went into `events.replay.v3` (3,118 rejects archived). The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is running (~61% after ~55 min), so the incident stays open until ClickHouse counts match. (source: r2-01, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill job `backfill-2026-11-12`, at ~61%, hours 15–23 in progress (source: r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour against the same weekday last week with 1% tolerance, then close the incident (source: r2-06, r2-08, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with `--batch 50000` was OOMKilled at the 2 Gi limit; 5k batches work and the memory limit must not be touched (Noa's namespace quota) (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [question] Orbitly asks engineering to confirm the restoration date for their board report (source: src-zendesk-orbitly)
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3` and never produce to `events.v3` directly; no other fix goes in for this incident (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Ignore PR #241 from the fork: Daniel's CI check is the fix that was decided, not a dedup key length change (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] The incident stays open until the counts match; Rachel told Fernhill and Orbitly the data is back by Thursday (source: r2-07)
